title: The City That Turned Around
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever changed direction — not because you understood everything, but because you knew it was time?
reflectionText: The most powerful city on earth heard eight words from a stranger and changed everything. No miracles. No signs. The king's decree did not promise anything — it said: Who knows? Maybe God will relent. What is it to turn around without certainty, holding nothing but hope with open hands, and to find that the turning is what mattered all along?
